sensor: Thermal: VOx uncooled focal plane array, 384x288, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 35 mK; optical: bullet 1/2.7in CMOS (4 MP) + speed dome 1/1.8in CMOS
features: thermal smart linkage tracking system: bi-spectrum bullet plus optical PTZ speed dome
thermal detector: VOx uncooled 384x288, 17 um pixel pitch, NETD < 35 mK, 8-14 um; 9.7 mm lens (37.5 x 28.5 FOV)
bullet optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 1/2.7in CMOS, 4 mm lens (84 x 44.8 FOV)
optical PTZ speed dome: 2688x1520, 1/1.8in CMOS, 6 to 252 mm 42x optical zoom, IR up to 400 m
smart auto/manual linkage tracking of up to 30 targets, one-touch bullet-to-PTZ alignment
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, +/-8 C (3 rule types: 10 points, 10 areas, 1 line)
dynamic fire detection (up to 10 fire points), intrusion and line-crossing event tracking
microSD storage up to 256 GB, ONVIF / RTSP, one 24 VAC supply for whole system
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TX3742-10P is a thermal smart linkage tracking system combining a bi-spectrum bullet camera (384x288 uncooled thermal plus 4 MP optical, 9.7 mm thermal lens) with a 42x optical PTZ speed dome (400 m IR) that auto-tracks up to 30 moving targets, adding temperature measurement and fire detection; the P variant uses a taller pole/bracket housing. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Bi-spectrum bullet (thermal + optical) and optical PTZ speed dome are exposed as separate channels.
